{{Short description|British materials chemist}}
'''John William Goodby''' is a British [[materials chemistry|materials chemist]].

He is the Chairman of Materials Chemistry at the [[University of York]].<ref>[https://www.york.ac.uk/chemistry/staff/academic/d-g/jgoodby/ His page on the University of York website]</ref> He studies [[liquid crystals]], [[complex fluids]] and [[self-organising systems]]. He was elected a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] in 2011<ref>[https://royalsociety.org/people/john-goodby-11515/ John Goodby on the Royal Society website]</ref> and received their [[Royal Medal]] in 2016 "for his major advances and discoveries of new forms of matter and materials, in particular the development of chiral liquid crystals."<ref>[https://royalsociety.org/grants-schemes-awards/awards/royal-medal/ Royal Medallists on the Royal Society website]</ref>
